nodes.name: chatgpt-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the ChatGPTAdapter class that parses ChatGPT conversation export JSON files into the hive-mind harvest item format, handling multiple conversation structures and tree-based message mappings.

nodes.name: ChatGPTAdapter
nodes.summary: Parses ChatGPT export JSON into normalized harvest items, traversing mapping trees and extracting text from multi-part message content.

nodes.name: chunk-utils.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a paragraph-based text chunking utility used by PDF and plaintext adapters to split large documents into manageable segments.

nodes.name: chunkByParagraphs
nodes.summary: Splits text into chunks at paragraph boundaries, respecting a maximum length constraint.

nodes.name: claude-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the ClaudeAdapter class that parses Claude.ai export JSON, handling conversations, project docs, memories, and design chat records into normalized harvest items.

nodes.name: ClaudeAdapter
nodes.summary: Multi-format Claude export parser supporting conversations, project docs, memories, and design chats with structured content block handling.

nodes.name: claude-code-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the ClaudeCodeAdapter class that scans local Claude Code project directories, extracting memory files, plans, preferences, and decision records into harvest items.

nodes.name: ClaudeCodeAdapter
nodes.summary: Scans Claude Code project directories for memory docs, plans, preferences, and mind-dir files, extracting structured decision records via pattern matching.

nodes.name: dedup.ts
nodes.summary: Provides content deduplication for harvest items using SHA-256 content hashes and trigram similarity scoring to filter out near-duplicate entries.

nodes.name: dedup
nodes.summary: Filters incoming harvest items against existing content using hash-exact and trigram-similarity deduplication, returning unique items and flagged contradictions.

nodes.name: harvestSetHash
nodes.summary: Computes a stable SHA-256 hash over a sorted set of harvest items for idempotent run detection.

nodes.name: extract-kg-entities.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts knowledge-graph entities from memory frames using LLM batch calls, writing named entities with types and properties into the KnowledgeGraph store with injection-scan protection.

nodes.name: extractKgEntities
nodes.summary: Batches dated frames, calls the LLM for entity extraction, and parses JSONL output into typed entity lists with error collection.

nodes.name: writeKgEntities
nodes.summary: Writes extracted entities to the KnowledgeGraph, merging with existing entities by name or creating new ones, with noise-name filtering.

nodes.name: extract-memory-lanes.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts facts, events, and profile cards from conversation text via three parallel LLM passes, writing them as typed memory frames with injection-scan protection.

nodes.name: extractMemoryLanes
nodes.summary: Runs three concurrent LLM extraction passes (facts, events, profiles) over a text input and collects results into typed lane arrays.

nodes.name: writeMemoryLaneFrames
nodes.summary: Writes fact, event, and profile extraction results as typed IFrames into the FrameStore, using injection-scan guards before each write.

nodes.name: gemini-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the GeminiAdapter class that parses Google Gemini/AI Studio export JSON into normalized harvest items, handling both array and nested conversation formats with media caption parity.

nodes.name: GeminiAdapter
nodes.summary: Parses Gemini export data supporting multiple conversation container shapes with W4.4 media-caption extraction for fileData and inlineData parts.

nodes.name: markdown-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the MarkdownAdapter that ingests markdown files or text, splitting by headings into section-level harvest items with bold-term tag extraction.

nodes.name: MarkdownAdapter
nodes.summary: Reads markdown from file paths or raw text, splits by heading-anchored sections, and extracts bold terms as metadata tags for each item.

nodes.name: pdf-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the PdfAdapter that dynamically imports pdf-parse to extract text from PDF files, splitting content into paragraph chunks for harvest ingestion.

nodes.name: PdfAdapter
nodes.summary: Uses dynamic import of pdf-parse to convert PDF buffers into chunked text harvest items with document metadata extracted from PDF info.

nodes.name: perplexity-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the PerplexityAdapter that parses Perplexity AI export formats (arrays, threads, single conversations) into harvest items with source-URL extraction.

nodes.name: PerplexityAdapter
nodes.summary: Handles multiple Perplexity export container shapes, extracts cited URLs as sources, and resolves ambiguous role labels across format variants.

nodes.name: pipeline.ts
nodes.summary: Core harvest processing pipeline implementing classify, extract, and synthesize stages with batched LLM calls, concurrency control, injection scanning, and deduplication.

nodes.name: HarvestPipeline
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full harvest pipeline: injection scan → classify → extract → synthesize → dedup, with configurable batch sizes, concurrency limits, and progress callbacks.

nodes.name: plaintext-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the PlaintextAdapter that reads plain text files or raw text input and chunks them into paragraph-based harvest items.

nodes.name: PlaintextAdapter
nodes.summary: Simple text ingestion adapter that reads files or raw strings and splits content into paragraph chunks for harvest processing.

nodes.name: prompts.ts
nodes.summary: Exports the three LLM prompt templates (CLASSIFY_PROMPT, EXTRACT_PROMPT, SYNTHESIZE_PROMPT) used by the harvest pipeline stages.

nodes.name: raw-turns.ts
nodes.summary: Manages raw conversation turn storage as IFrames in the FrameStore, providing header encoding/parsing utilities and the writeRawTurnFrames function for the raw-detail memory lane.

nodes.name: writeRawTurnFrames
nodes.summary: Writes individual conversation turn frames into the FrameStore with injection scan protection, per-turn deduplication by conversation key, and turn-count limiting.

nodes.name: raw-types.ts
nodes.summary: Provides type-safe runtime accessor utilities (asRecord, getString, getNumber, getArray, firstString) for safely traversing unknown JSON payloads from AI export files.

nodes.name: run-store.ts
nodes.summary: Implements HarvestRunStore, a SQLite-backed store for tracking harvest run lifecycle (start/heartbeat/complete/fail/abandon) with resumable interrupted-run detection.

nodes.name: HarvestRunStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed run tracker for harvest operations with status lifecycle management, progress heartbeat, and interrupted-run resumption queries.

nodes.name: source-store.ts
nodes.summary: Implements HarvestSourceStore, a SQLite-backed registry for harvest source configurations with auto-sync scheduling and stale-source detection.

nodes.name: HarvestSourceStore
nodes.summary: SQLite registry for harvest sources tracking display names, paths, sync counters, frame counts, and auto-sync intervals with stale-source queries.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the core harvest domain types and interfaces (HarvestItem, HarvestAdapter, HarvestSource, etc.) shared across all adapters and pipeline components.

nodes.name: universal-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the UniversalAdapter as a fallback parser that auto-detects source type by heuristic and handles arbitrary JSON conversation structures and plain-text formats.

nodes.name: UniversalAdapter
nodes.summary: Generic fallback adapter with source-type auto-detection, recursive conversation-tree discovery, and multi-format text/JSON parsing for unknown AI export shapes.

nodes.name: url-adapter.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the UrlAdapter that fetches web pages or parses inline HTML, extracting title, description, and section-split plain-text content as harvest items.

nodes.name: UrlAdapter
nodes.summary: Fetches URLs with timeout and parses HTML into structured harvest items using stripped plain text with heading-based sectioning.

nodes.name: injection-scanner.ts
nodes.summary: Exports scanForInjection(), a three-pattern security scanner that detects prompt-injection attempts in external content before it enters the memory substrate.

nodes.name: scanForInjection
nodes.summary: Tests text against three regex pattern sets (role override, instruction injection, context manipulation) and returns a scan result with matched flags and risk score.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Exports createCoreLogger(), a lightweight tagged logger factory providing warn/info/error/fatal methods used throughout the hive-mind-core package.

nodes.name: createCoreLogger
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a tagged logger object routing warn/info/error/fatal to console methods, used as the package-wide logging abstraction.

nodes.name: api-embedder.ts
nodes.summary: Implements createApiEmbedder(), an HTTP-based embedding provider that calls an OpenAI-compatible embeddings API with timeout, batching, and dimension normalization.

nodes.name: createApiEmbedder
nodes.summary: Factory that creates an embedding client calling an HTTP API endpoint, with per-request timeout, dimension normalization, and both single-text and batch modes.

nodes.name: awareness.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the AwarenessLayer class providing SQLite-backed active-task and state tracking with priority ordering, TTL expiry, category filtering, and context serialization.

nodes.name: AwarenessLayer
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed awareness store tracking active tasks and state items with priority ordering, TTL expiry, category bucketing, metadata JSON fields, and context-string serialization.

nodes.name: chunker.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the mind chunker that splits memory frames into overlapping token-bounded segments for vector-indexed chunk retrieval (HybridSearch chunk lane).

nodes.name: concept-tracker.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the ConceptTracker class that maintains a SQLite-backed frequency map of concepts mentioned in memory frames, used for ontology and relevance scoring.

nodes.name: content-hash.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a SHA-256 content hashing utility for deduplicating memory frames at the storage layer, used by FrameStore and db.ts.

nodes.name: db.ts
nodes.summary: Central database initialization module that opens/creates the SQLite database, applies schema migrations, and provides the MindDb accessor class used by all mind subsystems.

nodes.name: embedding-provider.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the EmbeddingProvider orchestrator that selects and initializes the appropriate embedder backend (in-process, API, LiteLLM, Ollama) based on configuration, with fallback logic and dimension validation.

nodes.name: embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the Embedder interface and related types as a barrel entry point for the embedding subsystem.

nodes.name: entity-normalizer.ts
nodes.summary: Provides entity name normalization and noise-name filtering utilities used during knowledge graph entity extraction to canonicalize names and filter out non-entity strings.
